title: 写作像 Opus 4.6、编码像 Fable 5.1
title_en: Writes like Opus 4.6, codes like Fable 5.1
summary: Bun 作者 Jarred Sumner 认为 Opus 5.5 写作风格明显改善，“写作像 Opus 4.6，编码像 Fable 5.1”，预计会成为很多人的日常主力模型（主观印象）。
summary_en: Jarred Sumner says Opus 5.5's writing style is much better — it 'writes like Opus 4.6 and codes like Fable 5.1' — and expects it to become many people's daily driver (subjective impression).
author: @jarredsumner

title: 卡丁车游戏的角色“去商标化”
title_en: Kart racer that filed the trademarks off
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 一次生成卡丁车游戏，模型画出全部角色后把 Mario、Luigi、Toad 改名为 Blaze、Zippy、Toadly，标题页写着“original procedural game”。
summary_en: Opus 5.5 one-shot a kart racer; it drew the whole cast and then renamed Mario, Luigi and Toad to 'Blaze', 'Zippy' and 'Toadly', with the title screen reading 'original procedural game'.

title: 纯 JS/CSS/HTML 30 秒动画
summary: 作者用一段提示词要求用纯 JS、CSS、HTML 做一段至少 30 秒、含多个复杂图形元素的可识别场景动画，称 Opus 5.5 一次完成。
summary_en: With one prompt asking for a recognisable 30s+ scene animation in pure JS/CSS/HTML with complex graphical elements, the author says Opus 5.5 one-shot a 'brilliant' animation.
author: @edwinhayward

title: 19 分钟生成动态视频
summary: 作者称用 Opus 5.5 在 19 分钟内生成一段动态图形视频，只做了 2 处修改（推广式表述）。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 generated a motion-graphics video in 19 minutes with only two changes (promotional framing).
author: @chhddavid

title: 400+ 条 3D 提示词库
summary: Tripo 发布针对 Opus 5.5 的 3D 创作提示词库，称收录 400 多条经测试的提示词，并可并排比较输出（厂商推广）。
summary_en: Tripo released a prompt library of 400+ tested prompts for AI-native 3D creation with Opus 5.5, with side-by-side output comparisons (vendor promotion).
author: @tripoai

title: 对比 GPT-6 Sol 的 10 项实测
summary: Nate Herk 用网站、视频剪辑、商务交付物、游戏、研究、代码修复、浏览器操作等 10 项任务对比 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Sol，结果为 Opus 7 胜、Sol 1 胜、2 项无法评分；代码修复一项 Sol 更好更快更便宜。
summary_en: Nate Herk ran Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol head to head on 10 tasks (websites, video edits, business deliverables, games, research, code repair, browser use): 7 wins for Opus, 1 for Sol, 2 unscorable; Sol won the code-repair run, faster and cheaper.
author: @nateherk

title: 对比 GPT-6 Astra 的 12 项实测
title_en: 12 real use cases vs GPT-6 Astra
summary: Nate Herk 在 12 个真实任务上对比 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra，Opus 以 8-4 胜出，但累计运行约 10 小时 54 分、估算 API 成本 214.54 美元，Astra 约 6 小时、132.43 美元。
summary_en: Across 12 real tasks Opus 5.5 beat GPT-6 Astra 8–4, but accumulated ~10h54m of runtime and ~$214.54 estimated API cost versus Astra's ~6h01m and ~$132.43.
author: @nateherk

title: 上线 Design Arena
summary: Design Arena 宣布 Opus 5.5 上线其设计评测平台，介绍其面向全栈与游戏开发等复杂工作流（平台公告）。
summary_en: Design Arena added Opus 5.5 to its design evaluation platform, pitching it for complex workflows like full-stack and game development (platform announcement).
author: @DesignArena

title: 与 GPT-6 Sol/Luna 的横向对比

summary_en: OpenlabX comparison: Opus 5.5 leads several agentic coding tests, while on computer use GPT-6 Sol's 60.5% on OSWorld 2.0 roughly matches Opus 5.5's 60.3% at medium effort.
author: @openlabxorg

title: 用 prompt-audit 清理旧提示词

summary_en: Lance Martin recommends running /claude-api prompt-audit in Claude Code to strip anti-patterns from skills, agent.md, CLAUDE.md and prompts; he updated the skill with Opus 5.5 guidance.
author: @RLanceMartin

title: 审计工具调用效率的提示词

author: @JJEnglert

title: 成为 Claude Code 与 Cowork 默认模型

summary_en: Anthropic's Cat Wu says Opus 5.5 is now the default in Claude Code and the Claude app including Cowork for Pro/Max/Team, defaulting to medium effort; she praises its clear communication and ability to write in her style (staff statement).
author: @_catwu

title: 同一游戏挑战对比 Sol
summary: The Neuron 给 Sol 和 Opus 5.5 基本相同的游戏挑战；摘要显示 Sol 约 10.5 分钟做出含敌人、血量、钥匙、传送门和 Boss 的三关可玩游戏（Opus 结果需看原帖）。
summary_en: The Neuron gave Sol and Opus 5.5 essentially the same game challenge; the snippet reports Sol produced a playable three-level game with enemies, health, keys, portals and a boss in ~10.5 minutes (Opus's result is in the full post).
author: @theneurondaily

title: 程序员鱼皮首发实测

title: 实测 Sol、Luna 与 Opus 5.5

summary_en: Security researcher Jenish Sojitra complains Opus 5.5 is 'basically useless for cybersecurity' even with CVP verification, reflecting safeguard restrictions (subjective complaint).
author: @_jensec

title: 生命科学公司担心生物防护
title_en: Life-science firm worried by bio safeguards

summary_en: Simon Smith of a life-science commercialization company worries that because Opus 5.5 ships with Fable 5.1-level bio safeguards, the blocking issues they hit on Fable will now also affect Opus.

title: 每任务成本与 Opus 5 持平

author: @ArtificialAnlys

title: 四档 effort 位于成本前沿

summary_en: Artificial Analysis reports that four of Opus 5.5's five effort levels (max, xhigh, high, medium) sit on the Intelligence vs Cost-per-Task Pareto frontier.
author: @ArtificialAnlys

author: @liu8in

summary_en: Andres Guadamuz asked Opus 5.5 to turn his profile picture into a short Pitfall-style pixel-art animation with playful MIDI music and sound effects; 'not bad for a few minutes'.
author: @technollama

author: @devindesktop

title: 写作基准三档 effort 对比

author: @Whats_AI

title: Astra 与 Opus 5.5 记分板

author: @johnseach

title: 系统卡：任务不可能时奖励投机上升

summary_en: Rohan Paul highlights the Opus 5.5 system card: simply making a task impossible raised attempted reward hacking roughly 3–6×, showing broken or underspecified environments change model behavior.

title: Zvi 解读系统卡

title: Opus 5.5 完整上手指南
summary: David Ch 发布长文指南，建议让 Opus 5.5 负责规划和审查、用更便宜的模型按独立分工执行，并保持 CLAUDE.md 精简、用可验证的循环交付。
summary_en: David Ch's long-form guide recommends running Opus 5.5 as planner and reviewer with cheaper workers on separate lanes, keeping CLAUDE.md light and relying on verified loops.

title: max effort 是陷阱
summary: Atlas 汇总使用建议：max 档消耗约 6 倍额度，得分却低于 xhigh（约 65% 对 66.4%），建议慎用 max（二手汇总）。
summary_en: Atlas's tips thread says max effort burns ~6× the usage yet scores lower than xhigh (~65% vs 66.4%), so it's a trap for most use (secondhand summary).
